nodes.name: Context Map.md
nodes.summary: Root architecture node defining the 6 bounded contexts of the autonomous trading engine (Data Pipeline, Trading Engine, Risk Control, Agent Runtime, Evaluation Loop, Supervisor Office) and the 8 cross-system interface contracts between them.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev_graph architecture node (ARCH-001, type: architecture, architecture_type: context_map) with a Mermaid flowchart of system boundaries; the canonical structural root every engineering session starts from.

nodes.name: Infrastructure Diagram.md
nodes.summary: Full infrastructure topology diagram covering all substrates, MCP servers, databases (Neo4j, SQLite), and data flows between raw sources, the wiki, and the dev_graph; documents the read-only Neo4j projection and sync pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev_graph architecture node (ARCH-004, architecture_type: context_map, implementation_status: implemented) with a large Mermaid graph; references .mcp.json, neo4j.env, and dev_graph/sync_to_neo4j.py via related_files frontmatter.

nodes.name: Layer Model.md
nodes.summary: Defines the three-layer vertical decomposition of the trading pipeline — L1 Data Ingestion, L2 Analysis & Strategy (the Snapshot layer / single source of truth), and L3 Execution — with each layer's inputs, outputs, capabilities, and failure modes.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev_graph architecture node (ARCH-003, architecture_type: layer_model); centers on the Layer 2 Snapshot Schema (SCHEMA-001) as the foundational breaking-change-sensitive data contract.

nodes.name: Runtime Topology.md
nodes.summary: Runtime component interaction model showing how the 6 systems communicate at execution time through events, interfaces, and data flows, including an event flow table and the daily runtime scheduling routines.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev_graph architecture node (ARCH-002, architecture_type: runtime_topology) with a Mermaid sequenceDiagram of the signal-to-execution flow; defines target event-driven behavior ahead of Phase 7 event-node implementation.
